instruction: Open Visual Studio Code, create 'README.md' in /home/user/project1, and enter 'Hello World' in the file.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a new file named 'README.md' in /home/user/project1 with content 'Hello World'. The evaluator verifies: (1) the file exists (50% score), and (2) it contains the exact text 'Hello World' (50% score). Custom getter retrieves the file from VM and decodes its content, custom metric compares actual vs expected content with whitespace normalization.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator verifies both file existence (50%) and content match (50%), covering all instruction requirements
Correct getter logic: Retrieves file from VM using env.controller.get_file(), properly decodes UTF-8 content, handles file-not-found cases
Correct metric logic: Checks file existence first, then compares content with strip() for whitespace normalization, uses exact match appropriate for 'Hello World' requirement
Proper expected parameter handling: Metric correctly accesses expected.get('expected_content') to retrieve value from rules dict
Appropriate partial credit: 50% for file creation, 50% for content verification - logical split for this two-part task
No postconfig needed: File system state persists after task completion, no UI-dependent verification required
Edge cases handled: File not found returns exists=False, decode errors handled with try-except
